item.title: How to Parse (Relatively) Complex C/C++ Types?
item.description:
I learned about the type distinction between array pointers and pointer arrays from the blog post of a lovely group member @0xa7973908, but such pure notation is really hard to memorize by rote. What’s the logic behind it, really? Let’s explore~

This issue’s header image is a screenshot from the MV of the song サイエンス (Science) by MIMI. It’s really pleasant to listen to, very fitting for us research dogs (). The MV was illustrated by 3774., whose art is adorable and rock-solid…
